honesty.status: DERIVED: each path is an order chosen by the rules printed under `rules`, over ids READ from the registries listed under `sources`. Nothing is fetched and no model runs.
honesty.not_partner: A union named here is a hall in the Academy's own taxonomy of trades. It is not a partner, sponsor or affiliate, it has not reviewed or endorsed any of this, and no real local is named.
honesty.nothing_invented: No apprenticeship hours, wages, credentials, membership or affiliation are stated or implied for any hall; the build refuses a derived record that carries one.
honesty.programmes: Any tie to a real apprenticeship programme is PROPOSED: no agreement exists with any union, programme or employer.
honesty.voice: An advisor or crew role is SCRIPTED: no AI model, the device's own speech synthesis, only on a click, with AUTHORED personalities (hive/registry/hive.json).

honesty_quoted.text: a taxonomy of skilled trades, not a roster of chartered locals; no union has reviewed or endorsed it
the Academy's own regional training structure across its planned campuses - not a claim about any real union's locals, chapters or jurisdictions; no local is named
planned locations named for real cities; no site has been surveyed, no address is recorded, and no figure comes from any city's records
unverified general practice. The lessons a course lists have not been reviewed by a journey-level practitioner, and grouping them does not change that.
no course certifies, qualifies or permits anybody to do anything. Finishing every lesson in a course leaves a learner with exactly the standing they started with.

rules.order: course, then its lessons, then its seats, then its tool crib, then its advisor, then its crews - one path per hall
rules.course: courses/registry/courses.json#courses["trade.<hall slug>"]; the course must name the hall and agree with the union registry on name, focus and district
rules.lessons: the trade course's outline, which the course rule orders by ladder depth, then the lessons registry order
rules.seats: the trade course's seat_time.seats_bound, in registry order (every seat a lesson uses is among them)
rules.crib: tools/registry/toolcribs.json#hall_bindings[<hall>].district names the crib; it must be the hall's own district
rules.advisor: the first advisor named by the hall's lesson supplements (where.advisors), in ladder order; a hall whose lessons name none gets the Orientation guide, the advisor that stands at every hall's door
rules.crews: every crew in agents/registry/crews.json whose halls list names the hall, in registry order, with its roles as hive/registry/hive.json ids; a crew's seat must be one of the hall's bound seats
rules.district_rollup: unions/registry/districts.json order; halls in union registry order; seats, crews and advisors counted once each, in order of first appearance
rules.cohort_rollup: unions.json#cohorts order; the hall count must equal the cohort's own count

counts_why: hours, wages and credentials are null and affiliations 0 because no registry records any; none is invented
